a11y.text: Renders an <aside aria-label="Sidebar"> containing a <nav aria-label="Main"> with a <ul> of <a> items.
The toggle is an Icon Button labelled "Collapse sidebar" or "Expand sidebar", with aria-expanded and aria-controls pointing at the nav.
When collapsed, each item keeps its label as aria-label and the visible label is removed; no tooltip or title is rendered.
The divider and spacer are aria-hidden="true".
Use a nav element with aria-label="Back Office", with one link per item.
Set aria-current="page" on the active item.
Make the menu and maximize buttons real buttons with aria-label="Collapse sidebar" and "Expand sidebar", and set aria-expanded.
Keep each item’s label as its aria-label, and show it as a tooltip on hover and focus.
White on the green and dark text on the yellow are both above 4.5:1.

differences.detail: Figma asks for the nav to be labelled aria-label="Back Office". The code labels the nav "Main" and wraps it in an <aside aria-label="Sidebar">.

Figma asks for each collapsed item's label to show as a tooltip on hover and focus (also best practice 206:1166 and the Do-not rule 206:1156). The code sets aria-label only and renders no tooltip or title.
